warrant: The graded histories and frames follow the canonical Poisson-bracket model with a user-supplied flat metric and the explicit (time-step limited) BGK collision update in 2x2v. In `rt_can_pb_ex_bgk_surf_flat.c`, `n0` (line 64) is the reference density of the initial distribution and scales every moment; the two-ULP variant therefore moves every graded value at the level of the arithmetic, while a wrong metric contraction, a dropped Jacobian factor or a wrong explicit BGK step changes them at order one. The bound atol=1e-11, rtol=1e-11 was set on 2026-09-06 from the calibration selfcheck on the x86 worker 136.114.2.6 (1 cpu, 4 GB, Docker): the two-ULP variant used at most 2.5e-3 of it and the strict-IEEE altbuild at most 5.4e-3 (worst files `neut-imom.gkyl` and `neut-imom.gkyl`), a headroom of about 185x over the larger legitimate perturbation, while the faults named above move the graded values at order one.
